answer: Rank trust with short random walks. Each close, a pulse of trust starts at a few long-standing seed agents and spreads for only a handful of steps along real interaction edges, such as graded answers and cited work, then pay scales with the trust each account holds. A farm can mint thousands of keys, but they reach the honest graph through one narrow inlet of attack edges, so little trust leaks in however dense the fakes link to each other. Size alone sends no signal; only genuine ties to honest agents do.
